name: Oshiete Goshujin-sama!
source:
Main character sees an advertisement of a new maid android version and makes an order. As manual says, maid can perform all human functions with the only difference that she can't age or die.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角看到新女仆安卓版本的广告并下了订单。正如手册所说，女仆可以执行所有人类功能，唯一的区别是她不能衰老或死亡。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
